credits.title: The Input Problem
credits.overview: A gifted but troubled programmer, on the verge of creating breakthrough technology to restore lost memories, must race to save his Alzheimer's-afflicted father and repair a problematic home life before he loses everything at the hands of his ruthless CEO.

credits.title: Peter
credits.overview: A trans man caring for his father with alcohol-induced dementia finds unexpected reconnection when the disease grants him temporary anonymity.

credits.title: Speechless
credits.overview: Already feeling like a fish out of water among his straight, British-Jamaican clan, Drew’s anxiety spikes when someone steals the speech he’s meant to give at his sister’s wedding.

credits.title: Afterburn
credits.overview: Set against the backdrop of a postapocalyptic Earth whose Eastern Hemisphere was destroyed by a massive solar flare, leaving what life remains mutated from radiation and fallout. credits.title: The Killer's Game
credits.overview: When top hitman Joe Flood is diagnosed with a terminal illness, he decides to take matters into his own hands – by taking a hit out on himself. But when the very hitmen he hired also target his ex-girlfriend, he must fend off an army of assassin colleagues and win back the love of his life before it's too late.

credits.title: Guests
credits.overview: In 1972, A Nigerian woman hosts her English colleague for dinner in the hope of getting her prideful husband a job.

credits.title: The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes
credits.overview: 64 years before he becomes the tyrannical president of Panem, Coriolanus Snow sees a chance for a change in fortunes when he mentors Lucy Gray Baird, the female tribute from District 12.

credits.title: Man>Code
credits.overview: Techie Lucas finds his casual hookup taking an unexpected turn.

credits.title: Kindling
credits.overview: A group of young men return to their home town in order to turn their friend's final days into a celebration of life and friendship.

credits.title: Kill Them with Kindness
credits.overview: A disillusioned diner waitress decides to take matters into her own hands with rude customers and deal with them how she's always been told - kill them with kindness.

credits.title: The Male Gaze: Strikers & Defenders
credits.overview: Work up a sweat from the soccer field to the locker room in these drama-fueled four films from Germany, France and the UK that explore how rivalry between teams can spill over into teacher-pupil relationships, high school crushes and brotherly compassion. credits.title: Crawl
credits.overview: When a huge hurricane hits her hometown in Florida, Haley ignores evacuation orders to look for her father. After finding him badly wounded, both are trapped by the flood. With virtually no time to escape the storm, they discover that rising water levels are the least of their problems.

credits.title: The Watchman
credits.overview: CCTV operator Carl becomes frustrated when the police refuse to tackle a gang of drug dealers. He takes the law into his own hands with devastating repercussions.

credits.title: Urban Hymn
credits.overview: Set against the backdrop of the 2011 UK summer riots, Jamie, a young female offender who possesses a remarkable voice, meets a determined social worker who inspires her to use it.

credits.title: Colours
credits.overview: In the aggressive and often hostile world of youth grass roots football, Adam faces an ultimatum from the team captain when they discover Adam's best friend Tom is gay.

credits.title: Beverley
credits.overview: Beverley is a short film written and directed by Alexander Thomas and produced by Cass Pennant and starring Vicky McClure and Laya Lewis. It follows the identity struggles of a mixed-race teenager who moves to white suburbia. Her fight to fit in with the local gang leads to devastating consequences.
